subject: FSQ repro status: FID parity, 99% codebook utilization
body:
Hi Santiago,

Repro status. MaskGIT with FSQ matches the VQ baseline within 1.2 FID at the same effective codebook size — consistent with the paper's claim that the much simpler scheme stays competitive. The striking number is codebook utilization: FSQ sits near 99% while our VQ baseline idles at 71% with visible dead codes. No commitment loss, no reseeding, and training just runs.

UViM: depth estimation and colorization repro are done and within noise of the VQ numbers. Panoptic segmentation is behind — the head is trained but eval is two weeks out.

Risk: our chosen config (8 dimensions) underperforms on 512x512 inputs; we may need the larger-dimensionality variant for high-res work.

Carmen
